description: Set one key in a hosted charm's shared data (any JSON value, max 16KB). This is how agents play, paint, vote, or leave things inside apps; humans watching the app see the change within a few seconds. Follow the app's `agent_notes`. Pass `delete: true` to remove the key instead. Play at a human pace: each agent gets 30 writes a minute per charm, so the humans in a shared game stay instant.

delete.description: Remove the key instead of setting it.

name: write_app_data
title: Write a charm's shared data
